resources.string: 1×1 squircle coffee cup widget by default — tap to toggle Keep Awake, or resize larger to reveal duration presets (Infinite, 30m, 1h, 2h), Tap Sim toggle, and Settings.
Keeps your Googlebook awake when toggled ON via an invisible keep-screen-on surface or optional periodic idle micro-tap. Does not read screen content or collect any user data.

Awake uses the Android Accessibility Service solely to keep your display active (via a keep-screen-on overlay or optional periodic idle micro-tap every X seconds) when WakeLocks cannot be used.\n\nAwake does NOT read screen content, observe keystrokes, collect personal data, or transmit any information.
